component.name: Co-Writer
component.summary: Local research and writing companion with Documancy

description.p: Co-Writer is a local research and writing companion. Its Documancy tools open, edit, reformat, recover, and export documents.

ul.li: Multi-tab editor with markdown formatting toolbar
Offline spelling and common grammar underlines
Local poetry tools, personal reading marks, rhyme maps, repetitions, and private craft notes
File browser sidebar with workspace management
Adaptive panes with show/hide controls; the AI pane hides first on smaller windows
Save indicators, close protection, unsaved draft recovery, and workspace restoration
Keyboard shortcuts, document search and replacement, and full Markdown preview
AI activity feedback and cancellation, with background model discovery
Zettelkasten notebook with wikilinks and backlinks
AI-powered document recovery for corrupt files
Ollama integration for editing, drafting, and rewriting
Guided assistant tasks and evidence checks using Europe PMC, arXiv and OpenAlex
Import from 9 formats including EPUB and MOBI
Export to 6 formats including PDF, DOCX, and ODT
Formatted Writer copies, PDF review, email drafts, Files shortcuts, and separate revised imports
Article and linked evidence handoff to Open Pressroom

description.p: Offline spelling and grammar underlines and local poetry tools help you refine your own writing. Explore rhythm, rhymes and repetitions, mark your reading, and keep private craft notes. This release also adds formatted desktop sharing and article handoff to Open Pressroom.

Co-Writer v4 adds Documancy, multi-tab editing, a file browser, notebook tools, markdown formatting, document recovery, model auto-detection, and comprehensive import/export. Adaptive panes keep the editor usable in smaller windows, with header controls to show or hide Files/Notebook and the AI assistant.
